comparison.objective: Move two open vials across a drip tray by hand-to-hand transfer and place them on pads; candidate removes and contains four metal tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual handoff of spill-sensitive open containers versus mandrel stabilization, controlled impact fracture, withdrawal, fragment search, and pickup.
comparison.success_condition: Both vials cross over the tray and finish on pads without the unsafe transfer path implied by the task; candidate requires all tangs in a tray with no escape or damage.
comparison.reason: Both emphasize containment and bimanual manipulation, but spill-safe vessel handoff does not test precision fracture, insert retention, or tiny-fragment recovery. Detailed spill thresholds are absent.
